item.title: WVSSAC approves girls wrestling for 2026-27 season
item.description: (WVSSAC Press Release) VIENNA, W.Va. — The West Virginia Secondary School Activities Commission Board of Directors voted on Tuesday night to approve girls wrestling as a preliminary sanctioned sport beginning with the 2026-27 school year. The decision establishes an official WVSSAC girls wrestling state championship supported by a regional qualifying format.
